payload.summary: Bounded discovery for extracting greeting-string construction from src/greeting.mjs into new internal module src/format.mjs. The entire behavior is one function: greet(name) in src/greeting.mjs builds `Hello, ${name}!` inline (line 2) — that template literal is the extraction target. src/format.mjs does not exist yet; src/ currently contains only greeting.mjs. Two configured required validators gate the change: fixture-greeting (node scripts/validate.mjs, also npm test) and contract-test (node scripts/contract.mjs); both are declared in .harness/project.yaml validation block and must stay unchanged. contract.mjs dynamically imports src/greeting.mjs and rejects any export key outside ["greet","FAREWELL"], so greeting.mjs must import format.mjs without re-exporting its symbols. Only consumers of greet are the two validator scripts; no other importer exists. Baseline validator execution could not be run in this role (shell denied); static reading indicates both currently pass.

relevantFiles.reason: Source of the refactor: greet(name) body contains the inline template literal `Hello, ${name}!` (line 2) to be extracted; must keep exporting exactly greet with identical behavior.
Target of the extraction; glob **/format.mjs returns no files, so it is a new internal module to be created. Must not be re-exported from greeting.mjs.
Configured validator fixture-greeting (required): asserts typeof greet === 'function' and greet('AEH') === 'Hello, AEH!'; also the target of package.json test script. Must remain unchanged.

Configured validator contract-test (required, adapter contract-test): asserts greet behavior and that Object.keys of src/greeting.mjs are within ['greet','FAREWELL'] — enforces the exact public export surface. Must remain unchanged.
Declares both configured validators (lines 269-281) plus their commands, required flags and timeouts; configuration must stay unchanged.
